description: This Java class converts HttpServletRequest objects into internal HttpRequest representations for MockServer, extracting headers, cookies, body, and connection details.

classes.name: HttpServletRequestToMockServerHttpRequestDecoder
classes.description: A decoder class that maps HttpServletRequest objects to internal HttpRequest objects for MockServer.

methods.name: mapHttpServletRequestToMockServerRequest
methods.description: Main method that converts HttpServletRequest to HttpRequest, setting method, path, query, body, headers, cookies, socket address, and connection properties.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the HTTP method in the HttpRequest from HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the request path, considering path info and request URI.

methods.name: setQueryString
methods.description: Parses and sets query string parameters if present.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Converts and sets the request body.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Extracts headers from HttpServletRequest and adds them to HttpRequest.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from HttpServletRequest and adds them to HttpRequest.

methods.name: setSocketAddress
methods.description: Sets socket address info based on request headers and local port.

methods.name: isKeepAlive
methods.description: Determines if the connection should be kept alive based on headers and protocol.
